Package com.monkey.ultimatebot.sdk.model.request

Class BotSpawnRequest

java.lang.Object
com.monkey.ultimatebot.sdk.model.request.BotSpawnRequest
Record Components:
mode - lifecycle and ownership mode
ownerUUID - optional owner UUID for owner-bound use cases
teamOwnerUUIDs - owner UUIDs used by team-allied bots
botUUID - optional explicit bot UUID; null generates one automatically
targetUUIDs - explicit target players for independent/event bots
botNameTemplate - bot display name or name template
botSkin - skin mode or player/texture reference
follow - whether follow logic is active
changeableFollow - whether players may change follow from the GUI
combat - whether combat logic is active
changeableCombat - whether players may change combat from the GUI
changeableBlast - whether players may change blast protection from the GUI
blastProtection - per-piece blast-protection state
changeableArmor - whether players may change armor from the GUI
changeableTotem - whether players may change totems from the GUI
changeableDifficulty - whether players may change difficulty from the GUI
changeableCombatMode - whether players may change combat mode from the GUI
armor - selected armor tier
minArmor - minimum random armor tier
maxArmor - maximum random armor tier
totemCount - selected totem count, or negative for random range
minTotemCount - minimum random totem count
maxTotemCount - maximum random totem count
difficulty - selected difficulty profile
minDifficulty - minimum random difficulty profile
maxDifficulty - maximum random difficulty profile
spawnLocation - optional explicit spawn position
autoTarget - whether automatic target acquisition is enabled
autoTargetRange - target acquisition range
attackBots - whether this bot may target other managed bots
targetMode - categories of living entities this bot may attack
respectWorldGuardPvp - whether PvP-disabled WorldGuard regions are avoided
stayAfterOwnerDeath - whether the bot remains after owner death
idleWander - whether idle wandering is enabled
idleWanderRadius - idle wandering radius
idleReturnDistance - distance that triggers return to spawn
idleReturnDelayMs - delay before returning to spawn
crystalPvp - whether crystal PvP logic is enabled
explosions - whether explosive combat is enabled
explosionBlockDamage - whether bot explosions may destroy terrain
enderPearls - whether ender pearl logic is enabled
healing - whether healing logic is enabled
killMessageEnabled - whether the built-in kill message is enabled
killMessage - custom kill message, or null for default
equipmentSlots - equipment-slot overrides kept active while the bot is running
combatMode - selected combat mode
brain - optional custom brain; null uses the brain assigned to the mode
combatTuning - optional tuning override for the selected mode and difficulty
public final class BotSpawnRequest extends Object
Complete request body used to spawn any supported remote bot type.
